items.question: How attainable is the divinely formed protective armor even under restricted transmission?
premises: The protective armor possesses supreme efficacy against obstacles and diseases.
The protective armor must never be spoken or given to anyone.
The speaker judges the divinely formed armor to be hard to obtain.
items.inference: Even within such restricted conditions, the divinely formed protective armor remains exceedingly rare.
uncertainties: Whether tatra refers specifically to the prohibition context or more generally to any situation is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Even there, I consider the divinely formed armor to be hard to obtain.
